verdict.rationale: Teller is an API-first product. It has documented public REST endpoints for balances, transactions, identity, payments (with idempotency) and account details, plus pagination, webhooks, mTLS authentication and a sandbox, and a community user built an export script calling it 'super easy to use.' For AI-native use, probes found no OpenAPI spec and no llms.txt or markdown docs index, and mTLS client-certificate setup adds friction for agent-driven access. Missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec, llms.txt/agent-oriented docs index, recent independent hands-on corroboration.
